name: @find-doc/finddoc-mcp

tools.name: search_doctors
tools.description: Search doctors by specialty, language, gender, and location. Availability is best-effort. Report each result's availability_updated_at when present, and tell the user to phone the clinic to confirm before relying on the result.

tools.name: get_doctor
tools.description: Look up a single doctor by CPSO number. Availability is best-effort. Report each result's availability_updated_at when present, and tell the user to phone the clinic to confirm before relying on the result.

tools.name: search_clinics
tools.description: Search clinics by location and acceptance status. Availability is best-effort. Report each result's availability_updated_at when present, and tell the user to phone the clinic to confirm before relying on the result.

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: Look up a single clinic by id. Availability is best-effort. Report each result's availability_updated_at when present, and tell the user to phone the clinic to confirm before relying on the result.

tools.name: get_availability_freshness
tools.description: Explains the availability freshness contract. No corpus-wide timestamp or coverage metric is available; use each clinic's availability_updated_at. Availability is best-effort. Report each result's availability_updated_at when present, and tell the user to phone the clinic to confirm before relying on the result.

tools.name: list_specialties
tools.description: Returns the list of supported specialty names accepted by search_doctors, with doctor counts. Availability is best-effort. Report each result's availability_updated_at when present, and tell the user to phone the clinic to confirm before relying on the result.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: Returns the list of supported language names and doctor counts. Availability is best-effort. Report each result's availability_updated_at when present, and tell the user to phone the clinic to confirm before relying on the result.

tools.name: get_clinic_reviews
tools.description: Get aggregated reviews and individual review entries for a clinic. Availability is best-effort. Report each result's availability_updated_at when present, and tell the user to phone the clinic to confirm before relying on the result.

tools.name: get_doctor_signals
tools.description: Get the per-dimension care signals for a doctor by CPSO number. The primary signals are `band` (strong/moderate/mixed/weak) and `strength` (0–1); `score` (1.0–5.0) is a derived convenience number. Dimensions with fewer than 3 reviews are omitted. Availability is best-effort. Report each result's availability_updated_at when present, and tell the user to phone the clinic to confirm before relying on the result.

tools.name: get_clinic_signals
tools.description: Get the per-dimension care signals for a clinic by id. The primary signals are `band` (strong/moderate/mixed/weak) and `strength` (0–1); `score` (1.0–5.0) is a derived convenience number. Dimensions with fewer than 3 reviews are omitted. Availability is best-effort. Report each result's availability_updated_at when present, and tell the user to phone the clinic to confirm before relying on the result.
